'''Zerah Dacan''' is a [[Mayene]]r [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zerah Dacan}}

== Appearance and Personality ==
Zerah is 5'5½" tall, and slim. She has black shoulder-length hair and large blue eyes. She is cool and self-possessed and moves gracefully.

==Strength and Abilities==
Zerah is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|25}}. 

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a [[Traveling|gateway]] of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

==History==
Zerah comes from a moderately wealthy family in Mayene; her father had been a merchant-trader .
<nowiki> </nowiki>She was born in {{ne|928}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|943}}. After spending seven years as a [[novice]] and eight years as [[Accepted]], Zerah was raised to the shawl in [[958 NE]]. She was allied with the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] during the [[White Tower Schism|White Tower schism]].

She has no Warder.

== Activities ==
Zerah, as well as nine other sisters, was sent by the [[Salidar]] Aes Sedai to the [[White Tower]] to spy, and to spread the rumor that the [[Red Ajah]] set [[Logain Ablar]] up as a [[false Dragon]]{{ref/book|7|8}}{{ref/book|8|26}}.

Unfortunately, [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and [[Seaine Herimon]] suspected her of being [[Black Ajah]] and questioned her with the [[Oath Rod]], causing her to unwillingly betray her allegiance to the Salidar Aes Sedai, as well as the names of the other spies{{ref/book|9|p}}. She was also forced to swear an oath of obedience to Pevara and Seaine, which included luring each of the other ferrets into the same trap.

Zerah unwittingly demonstrated the problem of conflicting Oaths. Bound by the oath to not lie, and bound by the Oath to obey Pevara, Pevara told her to admit that the story of Reds setting up Logain as a False Dragon was a lie. Because Zerah believed it was truth, she could not obey Pevara. Zerah began to choke, and was only saved because Seaine figured out that the Oaths conflicted and urged Pevara to rescind her order.

She is now part of the [[Black Ajah Hunters|group of sisters who are hunting the Black Ajah]] in the White Tower.

"The Wheel of Time Companion" reveals that Egwene successfully convinced Seaine and the others to remove Zerah's oath of obedience.
